name: Huanghun Zhi Cheng
source:
Set in the backdrop of Japan in the 1990s, two teams accidentally find themselves in the Town of Dusk, which was built just before the fall of the Empire of Japan. There, they embark on a journey of deduction, adventure, and wit.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2428190/]Steam[/url]]
